result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I changed one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/.../landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`.

A contributor matched by no team is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. A blank latest-commit date already counts as active in `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, so those contributors stay in. Configured teams are untouched, because the check only applies to unmatched contributors.

I ran `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='Landscape*'`. It finished with no errors, but I didn't check whether any landscape test actually covers this path, and I didn't add a new test.
